verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Vercel enables agent-related building blocks (agent tools via docs-4, sandboxed execution via docs-3, AI-driven deploys with human handoff via docs-10, and git-push triggered deploy automation via docs-1), but nothing describes a scheduler, cron, or persistent background-automation runtime for fully autonomous, unattended agent workflows. missing for 10: explicit scheduled/cron job support, evidence of long-running unattended agent execution, and independent confirmation that such automations run without human handoff.
